messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: realtime p95/p99 regression detected for /v1/generate (us-east-1). p95=1.2s (baseline ~250ms), p99=4.8s. Error rate stable, increased tail latency and streaming stalls. Auto-pager triggered.
tara: Oncall pinged. Sam are you available?
sam: Oncall here — seeing the alert. Pulling dashboards now.
miguel: I can help triage — adding myself. Any noted deploys in the last 30m?
incident-bot: Recent rollout: quant-llm-v2.3 (canary 10%) deployed 00:18 UTC. Autoscaling events at 00:22 UTC.
jess: Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/inference/slo-real-time?range=15m — p95 spike co-occurs with a jump in KV-cache miss rate and increased queue times on gpu-pool-3.
sam: Streaming stalls trace: most stalled connections show repeated small writes but backend token generation delayed ~3-5s. Not full error, just slow token emission.
tara: Customer impact check: no widespread 5xx, but support ticket from acme-corp reporting "chat lags" and slowed assistant replies. Notified CS.
miguel: Quick checks: tail latency per instance: `rql query cpu,latency from runtime where pool="gpu-pool-3" and window=5m` — results show a subset of nodes with p99 >> others.
oncall-sre: I can run a fast remediation: shift traffic off gpu-pool-3 to gpu-pool-2 as a controlled fallback. Suggest 20% shift and monitor.
sam: +1 for traffic reroute. Also start a scale-up on pool-2: `kubectl scale deployment/gpu-pool-2 --replicas=6` (ops creds).
jess: Can we confirm model kernel fallback? quant-llm-v2.3 on gpu-pool-3 uses a new fused attention kernel; fallback to scalar kernel available as quant-llm-v2.2.
tara: If we route to v2.2 fallback, expect slightly higher cost but lower latency. Recommend canary rollback if reroute stabilizes.
ops-bot: Runbook check: INCIDENT_RUNBOOK v3 — step 2: isolate affected nodes, step 3: fallback routing.
miguel: I see increased GC/alloc pauses inside the runtime on those nodes — logs show repeated KV cache thrash and small evictions. Could be workload pattern change + quant kernel memory pressure.
sam: Immediate plan: 1) Shift 20% traffic to pool-2, 2) Route new requests to model variant v2.2 for 10% of traffic, 3) Scale pool-2 by +2 replicas, 4) Monitor p95/p99 and streaming stall rate for 10m.
jess: Executed routing change: `redwoodctl route update --service=generate --region=us-east-1 --shift=pool-2:20%` — confirmed.
oncall-sre: Scaling pool-2 now.
incident-bot: Automation: created incident ticket INC-8600001111, webhook to postmortem owner assigned to @tara.
tara: Noting customer comms: ask CS to tell acme-corp we are investigating latency and may route around a node — ETA for initial mitigation 10-15m.
miguel: After routing change, p95 dropped to ~320ms after ~2m, p99 down to ~900ms. Streaming stall count decreased by 70%.
sam: Good. Continue monitoring for 30m, keep rollback option ready if any errors rise. Also re-run the quant kernel perf tests in sandbox.
jess: Created short timeline and flagged suspect nodes for deeper debug: `logs tail --filter node:gpu-3-4 --since 30m`
tara: Assigning post-incident actions: - validate quant kernel mem behavior; - improve kvcache eviction heuristics; - add alert for kv-miss spikes tied to tail latency.
incident-bot: Paging clear if p95/p99 remain within SLO for 30m.
ops-bot: SLA note: current rolling window shows SLO breach for 3m. Customer impact: limited to multi-turn streaming features for a subset of user sessions.
sam: Thanks team. I'll stay on watch for the next 30m and coordinate postmortem. :thumbsup:
